meta._subject_axis: 주체 판정 — 양쪽 다 국가(중국) 하나이므로 표면은 전부 오성홍기 구체다. 대립 축은 「국가 대 국가」가 아니라 「당국 대 그 나라 사람」이라, 구체 표면을 바꾸지 않고 규칙 1번대로 복장으로만 역할을 가른다: 정장+간부 모자 = 집행하는 당국(여유·무심), 작업복·앞치마 = 밀려나는 쪽(경악·낭패). 한국이 등장하지 않는 제3국 내부 서사이므로 「우리 쪽 구체」는 피해 당사자 구체로 치환해 9장 중 6장에 세웠다.
meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.
meta.negative_prompt: photorealistic human faces, real people, live-action photograph, human skin, english text, latin letters, fake chinese characters, gibberish text, random lettering, invented words, rising-sun flag

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「밤이 됐는데 창문에 불이 안 켜진다.」 verified-data §H 「불 꺼진 아파트 야경 — 창문 격자가 거의 전부 암흑, 불 켜진 창 한두 개」 + §D 도시 주택 공실률 21.4%·빈집 6,500만 채가 근거. 숫자 대신 「불빛의 부재」를 크기 대비로 말하는 컷이라 압도적 피사체 구도를 골랐다. 손전등을 든 작업복 구체는 밀려나지 않고 남은 쪽(피해 당사자)이다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain dark asphalt ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a colossal night-time apartment tower fills the centre and left of the upper five-eighths, its window grid drawn crisply row after row and almost entirely black, with exactly two windows glowing warm yellow. Standing small at the right in front of it is one countryball — a perfectly round glossy sphere whose entire surface is wrapped in the Chinese national flag, a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it, the stars large and unbroken across its front — dressed in a blue work jacket and yellow hard hat with small black gloved hands, holding up a metal flashlight whose beam cuts across the dark facade and lands on one of the lit windows. Its eyes are stretched wide with the whites fully showing and the pupils shrunk to pinpricks, its mouth open in a big round gasp, three cartoon sweat beads flying off the top of the sphere and short shake lines around it. A low estate marker beside it reads "베이징" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters. Cold blue moonlight and deep navy sky, the flag red of the sphere and the two yellow windows the only warm colour, faint haze between the tower and the camera.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「가게 문을 닫은 게 아니라 벽돌로 막았다.」 verified-data §6 개장타동 정비(계획 1.6만 곳 → 실제 2.3만 곳)와 §H 「벽돌 — 앞엣것은 시장의 결과고 뒤엣것은 누군가의 결정이다」가 근거. 표면이 양쪽 다 오성홍기이므로 복장으로 역할을 갈랐고, 간부 구체의 손이 실제로 벽돌을 쌓는 접촉을 만들어 「밀어냈다」가 허공에서 멈추지 않게 했다. 표정 온도는 여유 대 분노로 갈랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth paved alley floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: two countryballs face each other across the upper five-eighths, both spheres wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it, the stars large and unbroken across each front. On the left, in a dark buttoned suit and a peaked official's cap, one sphere is laying a fresh red brick onto a half-built brick wall that completely fills what used to be a shop doorway, its gloved hand pressing the brick down into wet mortar; its eyes are narrowed into smug half-moons and one corner of its mouth is curled up. On the right, in a shopkeeper's apron, the other sphere recoils with eyebrows drawn into a hard V, whites showing all around its pupils, mouth wrenched wide open with the lower teeth showing and a red anger mark throbbing on its cheek, both gloved hands thrown up. Above the sealed doorway the old shop signboard still hangs untouched, face-on, reading "잡화점" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters. Behind them a blurred grey alley of identical bricked-up shopfronts recedes, flat overcast daylight, dust motes and a few loose bricks in the air with motion trails.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「가게였던 자리가 창고가 됐다.」 verified-data §1 차이 사장 — 「우리 층에 점포가 100곳 넘게 있었는데 지금은 창고로 바뀌었거나, 문 여는 데는 서너 곳뿐」, 그리고 「손님 명단 공책이 20권에서 6권」. 세는 단위가 사람이 아니라 공책이라는 게 이 장면의 힘이라 공책 여섯 권을 손에 쥐여 물리화했다. 표정은 경악이 아니라 체념으로 1·2번과 갈랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth polished market floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a long wholesale-market corridor drives back into the upper five-eighths in one-point perspective, shutter after shutter rolled down along both walls with crisp metallic detail, stacked cardboard stock boxes crammed behind the one shutter left half open, and only a single distant unit still lit while the rest of the ceiling tubes are dead. Standing at the right, waist-up, is one countryball — a perfectly round glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese national flag, a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it, the stars large and unbroken across its front — in a shopkeeper's apron with small black gloved hands hugging a short stack of six worn ledger notebooks against itself. Its eyes are half-lidded and unfocused with dark shadow lines under them, its mouth pulled down into a flat resigned curve, one small sweat drop sliding down the sphere. A hanging directory board above the aisle is turned face-on and reads "의류 도매" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters. Cold blue-green fluorescent light, desaturated grey-green corridor, the sphere's flag red the only strong colour, shallow depth of field softening the far end.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「계획서에 적힌 여덟 글자」와 「밀어낸」을 한 화면에서 동시에 이행한다. verified-data §C — 「베이징 도시총체계획(2016~2035)」의 2,300만 상한과 「以房管人·以业控人」이 근거. 계획서를 쥔 손과 등을 미는 손을 같은 구체에 붙여 「종이 한 장이 사람을 밀어냈다」를 접촉으로 만든다. 밀려나는 쪽은 verified-data §4의 20대(배낭·캐리어)로 특정했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth stone plaza floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: two countryballs stand chest-to-chest across the upper five-eighths, both spheres wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it, the stars large and unbroken across each front. On the left, in a dark suit and a peaked official's cap, one sphere holds open a large official planning document turned face-on and wide enough to span a third of the frame, its cover header reading "도시계획" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters while the body lines beneath are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read; its other gloved hand is planted flat against the back of the sphere opposite, physically shoving it away. Its eyes are narrowed to cool indifferent slits and its mouth is a flat unbothered line. On the right, a sphere in a hooded jacket with a backpack strap and a rolling suitcase stumbles backward off balance, eyes bulging wide in different directions, mouth open in a small startled O, two sweat beads flying off and speed lines trailing behind it. Behind them a blurred line of small identical spheres with suitcases recedes toward a distant city gate, bright hard key light, red and grey dominating, paper sheets fluttering in the air with motion trails.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「20대 213만 명」을 숫자 자체로 이행한다. verified-data §4 — 베이징 20대 461.8만(2015) → 248.9만(2024), -212.9만, 비중 21.3%→11.4%. 전광판은 원래 큰 물건이므로 확대 장치 없이 그냥 크게 그려 160×90에서도 숫자가 읽히게 했다. 광장을 텅 비워 「밀어낸 결과」를 같은 화면에 넣는다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain dark plaza ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Scene: an enormous public LED board fills the centre and right of the upper five-eighths, turned face-on to the camera with crisp panel detail, carrying one huge clean white figure reading "213만" in Korean Hangul and numerals that spans most of the board's width, the smaller rows beneath printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Its jaw has dropped into a wide open gasp, its eyes are stretched upward and huge with tiny pupils, eyebrows shot up high, a single sweat bead at the top of the sphere. Cold dusk blue sky, harsh white board glare raking across the empty ground, flag red and screen white dominating, lens-flare sparkle on the board edge.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「불 꺼진 베이징 창문」을 표정 하나로 받는다. 텍스트를 전부 지워도 「저 창문들이 다 꺼졌고 그걸 보고 얼어붙었다」가 읽히는지로 설계했고, 그래서 이 장은 사물 문구를 넣지 않았다(빈 화면을 채우려 억지 라벨을 만들지 않는다). 근거는 verified-data §H 「불 꺼진 아파트 야경」과 §4 베이징 2년 연속 인구 감소.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain dark ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: one countryball fills almost the whole upper five-eighths in extreme close-up — a perfectly round glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese national flag, a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it, the stars large and unbroken and reaching the edges of the sphere — wearing a blue work jacket collar with one small black gloved hand clamped flat over its mouth. Behind it, thrown well out of focus, a wall of night-time apartment windows recedes as a soft dark grid with a single warm yellow window glowing between the sphere and the frame edge. Deep navy and blue-black background, strong specular highlight across the top of the sphere, the flag red blazing against the dead blue night.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 건물은 멀쩡히 다 서 있는데, 사람이 있어야 할 자리에 사람이 없다 — 빨간 원이 그 부재를 딱 한 곳만 지목한다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 좌측 상단 빨간 테두리 확대 서클과 그 지점으로 뻗는 굵은 빨간 화살표 · 현장 바깥에서 정면을 마주 보는 카메라 · 우측 3분의 1을 채우는 초대형 구체와 경악 표정, 중앙 중경의 작은 대열 / [바꿈] 피사체(무인 크레인 조종석 → 불 꺼진 아파트 창문 격자) · 무대(공사현장 → 야간 주거단지) · 배경 대열(퇴장하는 국기볼 줄 → 도시를 빠져나가는 이삿짐 트럭 실루엣). 거리감은 단지 전체가 보이는 넓은 화각. 계승 3장 중 7·8은 밀려난 쪽 구체로 세워 시청자 이입점을 남겼다.

In the upper left a bold red-outlined circular magnifier inset about one third of the frame width holds a crisp enlargement of that one lit window, and a single thick red arrow runs from the circle across to the exact window it came from; the circle stays entirely inside the upper five-eighths.
